item.title: Industry welcomes seven new towns sites, despite development doubts
item.description: Planning and real estate heavyweights have welcomed the government's confirmation of the first wave of new town locations, despite concerns over viability hurdle and how realistic the development timeframes are.

item.title: Landsec lodges plans for next phase of Portsmouth Gunwharf Quay regeneration
item.description: Landsec has submitted a planning application to refurbish the waterfront at the Gunwharf Quays shopping centre in Portsmouth, with enlarge terraces, refreshed façades and enhanced public realm.

item.title: AMCI Europe signs lease for Bicester Motion headquarters
item.description: Automotive events and training specialist AMCI Europe has taken the 7,410 sq ft Building 90 at Bicester Motion in Oxfordshire for its new European headquarters.

item.title: Bellway reports ‘robust’ performance with completions and revenues up
item.description: Housebuilder Bellway Homes has reported a solid performance in its interim results for the six months to the end of January, with revenue up 6.3% to £1.52bn and housing completions up 2.7% to 4,702.

item.title: Panattoni promotes Cripps to head of international capital markets
item.description: Industrial and logistics developer Panattoni has promoted Nick Cripps to head of international capital markets.

item.title: Regional REIT ramps up disposals in drive to strengthen balance sheet
item.description: Regional REIT has ramped up its disposal programme as it looks to strengthen its balance sheet and insulate itself from a cautious letting market.

item.title: Stanhope hires Mace to bring forward £450m South Bank office scheme
item.description: Development and asset manager Stanhope has appointed Mace Construct as main contractor to build its Bankside office scheme, with a £450m gross development value, on the South Bank in central London.

item.title: Hines and Chancerygate land Investec loan for £39m Oldham logistics scheme
item.description: Investec Bank has provided a senior development loan to Hines and Chancerygate to fund a 166,500 sq ft speculative urban logistics development in Oldham.

item.title: Future Homes Standard rules delayed until 2028
item.description: The long-awaited Future Homes Standard has been published today (24 March), setting out new energy efficiency requirements for low-carbon housing, but its implementation has been delayed until March 2028.

item.title: SENG secures £65.5m loan for two London office conversions
item.description: Specialist lenders ASK and Firma Partners have provided a £65.5m senior loan for private investor SENG's acquisition of the Regents House office building in London's Islington and its conversion of Chiswick Tower.

item.title: Final phase of Get Living’s £1.5bn Elephant and Castle scheme approved
item.description: Built-to-rent (BTR) giant Get Living has secured planning approval for the final phase of its £1.5bn Elephant and Castle redevelopment masterplan in south London, including 507 BTR homes.

item.title: Avison Young makes 44 senior promotions across the business
item.description: Global real estate adviser Avison Young has announced 44 senior promotions across the business at associate director and director levels.

item.title: Montagu Evans announces largest-ever round of promotions
item.description: Montagu Evans has unveiled its largest-ever round of promotions involving 35 people across the business, as part of its growth strategy.
